landing.heroTitle: Practice difficult conversations before they happen
landing.heroSubtitle: Simulate conversations with managers, clients, partners, or family. Get feedback and a script so you can express yourself more clearly.
landing.step1Desc: Describe who you're talking to, what you need to say, and how they tend to react.
landing.step2Desc: Practice with an AI that plays the other person based on your description.
landing.step3Desc: Receive scores, tips, and a ready-to-use script for the real conversation.
landing.situation1: Asking for a raise or negotiating salary
landing.situation2: Setting boundaries with a difficult client
landing.situation3: Talking to your partner about something sensitive
landing.situation4: Telling a friend something that hurt you
landing.disclaimer: ArgueBetter is a communication practice tool. It does not provide therapy, legal advice, or life decisions. You choose what to do in real life.

legal.privacyP1: ArgueBetter stores your account email, practice conversations, and feedback to provide the service. Conversation content is processed by AI providers to simulate role-play and generate feedback. We do not sell your data.
legal.privacyP2: You can request deletion of your account data by contacting support. This is a communication practice tool — not a medical or therapeutic service.
legal.termsP1: ArgueBetter is a communication practice tool. It helps you rehearse difficult conversations and improve how you express yourself. It does not provide therapy, legal advice, medical advice, or recommendations about major life decisions (relationships, employment, health, etc.).
legal.termsP2: You are solely responsible for your real-world conversations and choices. AI responses are simulated role-play, not predictions of what will actually happen.
